audience: Title teams, real estate operations leaders, and transaction coordinators
heroComposition: Large document-led value proposition paired with documentary closing-table photography and an ownership ledger
typeCharacter: High-contrast editorial serif with compact operational sans-serif copy
paletteFamily: Warm closing paper, evergreen ink, parchment, and restrained brass
shapeGrammar: Squared document fields, fine rules, ledger tabs, and selective keyhole curves
imageTreatment: Documentary closing photography, route-specific operational diagrams, and official Bacolod team evidence
sectionRhythm: Open editorial arguments alternating with dense document ledgers, dark decision bands, and narrow reading columns
navigationTreatment: Compact sticky three-link masthead with persistent parent attribution and keyboard mobile disclosure
motionSignature: One continuously recycled first-party review rail with static reduced-motion presentation
density: High-information and scan-friendly with generous editorial hierarchy
signatureElement: A closing ownership ledger that separates source evidence, specialist preparation, licensed review, and final authority

designRead.statement: Reading this as: a closing-operations staffing service for title teams and transaction leaders, with a composed, precise, document-led visual language, leaning toward architectural editorial minimalism.
designRead.primaryAccentStrategy: Use brass for evidence and focus cues, evergreen for primary actions and authority boundaries.
designRead.shapeSystem: Squared document geometry with fine rules and selective keyhole curves.
designRead.typographyDirection: Editorial serif display type with compact operational sans-serif copy.
designRead.imageDirection: Closing-specific documentary imagery and operational diagrams, plus official parent-team evidence.
designRead.motionRationale: Keep closing records and forms stable. Limit movement to the sourced review rail.
